### The Matchless Gift of Eternal Life
Author: Scotty Smith
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/scotty-smith/the-matchless-gift-of-eternal-life/
Passage: John 17:3
Points:
- Eternal life centers on intimately knowing the Father and the Son, not merely residing in heaven forever.
- Truly knowing Christ surpasses religious familiarity, doctrinal data, and moralistic education.
- The deepest human cravings for connection and intimacy are satisfied solely through relationship with God.
- Being completely known and loved by Jesus frees believers from spiritual pretending and exhausting performance.

### Glorifying God = Fulfilling the Mission
Author: Trevin Wax
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/trevin-wax/glorifying-god-fulfilling-the-mission/
Passage: John 17:4
Points:
- Jesus demonstrated that glorifying the Father means obediently completing the work God assigned Him.
- Believers bring glory to Christ not through abstract ideals, but by actively carrying out His mission.
- Genuine worship cannot be reduced to a passive weekly experience that simply produces good feelings.
- God places each believer in a specific time and location to proclaim the good news of His kingdom.
